clues: Cass and Boris went out on Monday and Wednesday, one on each day.
Imani went out exactly three days after the visitor from Dover.
Boris was not the visitor from Reno.
Of Boris and the visitor from Tulsa, one went out on Tuesday and the other on Wednesday.
hints: Look at clue 2. In a week that runs only from Monday to Thursday, how much room does a gap of exactly three days need?
Clue 2 is an exact gap, so count. Try the Dover visitor on each day and see where Imani would land.
So the Dover visitor went out on Monday and Imani on Thursday, the only days three apart. Clue 1 then leaves Tuesday for Hal.

solution.key_idea: Only Monday and Thursday are three days apart, so clue 2 puts the Dover visitor on Monday and Imani on Thursday.
steps: By clue 2, Imani went out exactly three days after the Dover visitor. Only Monday and Thursday are three days apart.
So the Dover visitor went out on Monday, and Imani on Thursday.
By clue 1, Cass and Boris took Monday and Wednesday, which leaves Tuesday for Hal.
Clue 4 puts Boris on Tuesday or Wednesday, and clue 1 on Monday or Wednesday. So Boris went out on Wednesday, and Cass on Monday.
Cass went out on Monday, so Cass is from Dover. By clue 4, the Tulsa visitor went out on Tuesday, so Hal is from Tulsa.
By clue 3, Boris is not from Reno, so he is from Buffalo and Imani is from Reno. Boris, Wednesday's guest, hauled up the lobster.
solution.epilogue: Boris from Buffalo hauled up Wednesday's lobster, and by the time Nico told the tale at the bakery, the lobster was the size of a canoe. Boris's photo showed something nearer a loaf of bread.

tip: Days of the week work like places in a line, with Monday at the front and Thursday at the back.
answer_line: Boris hauled up the canoe-sized lobster.
story: From Monday to Thursday, Nico took one summer visitor out on his lobster boat, Persistence, each morning, and no two came from the same town. He keeps his bookings in his head, right next to his lobster stories, and the two have begun to mix. He does know that Wednesday's guest hauled up the week's biggest lobster, which has since grown to the size of a canoe. Who went out on which day, and where was each visitor from?
